name: entity-to-struct-recipe
body: 1. Emit `type <Name> struct {`. 2. For each field, emit `\t<Field> <Type>` and, if the field has a tag, append ` `+"`json:\"<tag>\"`". 3. Emit `}`. 4. Run the result through gofmt.
residual: transcribing each field's name/type/tag into the template slots — no design judgment left
